items.text: The FCA fined a major UK bank £45m for systemic AML failures linked to a complex layering scheme involving shell companies across three jurisdictions. The enforcement signals tightening supervisory expectations around beneficial ownership verification.

FATF's latest typologies report flags AI-generated synthetic identities as an emerging vector for onboarding fraud at digital banks and crypto exchanges. Firms are urged to implement behavioural biometrics alongside document verification to counter this threat.
